title: Care Management Assessments, Reassessments and Care Plans
content:
Care Management assessments and care plans follow the timeframes of the member's tier, counted from the member's consent and from the initial assessment.

## Policy statement

1. **Initial assessment.** The initial assessment is completed within the tier's initial-assessment timeframe of consent, and repeated every tier reassessment interval in months, including a social needs screening where the tier requires one.
2. **Care plan.** A care plan is completed within the tier's care-plan timeframe of the initial assessment and reviewed every tier review interval in calendar days.
3. **Signature.** Where the tier requires the member's signature, the care plan takes effect only once signed by the member.
4. **Copy.** A copy of the care plan reaches the member within the tier's copy timeframe of signature.
5. **Status.** Assessments and care plans are recorded only on an episode in active status, as the system shows that episode's status before the assessment or the care plan is recorded.

Each completed or reviewed care plan is recorded as a new plan version, with its date and whether the member signed it.

## The clauses as a timeline

| Starting point | What follows | Timeframe |
|---|---|---|
| Consent | Initial assessment completed | Tier's initial-assessment days |
| Initial assessment | Reassessment | Every tier reassessment interval (months) |
| Initial assessment | Care plan completed | Tier's care-plan days |
| Care plan | Review | Every tier review interval (days) |
| Member's signature | Copy reaches the member | Tier's copy days |

## Signature and effect (hypothetical care plans in a tier that requires a signature)

| Plan version | Member signed | Plan in effect |
|---|---|---|
| Version 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Version 2 | No | No, not until signed |

## Status check (hypothetical episodes)

| Episode status | Assessment or care plan may be recorded |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Outreach | No |
| On hold | No |
| Closed | No |

A hypothetical member who consented on 5 January in a tier with a 30-day initial-assessment timeframe has the initial assessment due by 4 February. If the assessment is completed on 20 January and the tier's care-plan timeframe is also 30 days, the care plan is due by 19 February.
